title: Driving Bible
shortDescription: Practice Singapore BTT, FTT and RTT with section quizzes and official handbooks.
fullDescription:
Practice the Singapore Basic Theory Test (BTT), Final Theory Test (FTT), and Riding Theory Test (RTT).

Open a test type, pick a section, and answer one question at a time. The app marks each answer immediately and shows your score when the section is done.

No account. No ads. A network connection is required to load questions.

What you can do
- Practice BTT, FTT, and RTT from separate tabs
- Work through practice sections
- See correct or incorrect feedback on every question
- Recap your score at the end of a section
- Open the BTT, FTT, and RTT handbook PDFs in the app

What this app is not
Driving Bible is not an official Singapore Police Force or Traffic Police app. It is not a timed mock exam, and it does not cover the practical driving test.

Confirm you are studying the current handbook edition before sitting the test.
releaseNotes: First release. BTT, FTT, and RTT section practice, plus official handbook PDFs.

zh-CN.title: 新加坡驾考宝典
zh-CN.shortDescription: 练习新加坡 BTT、FTT、RTT。按章节刷题，并可打开官方 Handbook。
zh-CN.fullDescription:
练习新加坡理论考试：Basic Theory Test (BTT)、Final Theory Test (FTT)、Riding Theory Test (RTT)。

选一种考试，点一个章节，一题一题做。选完立刻显示对错，做完给出分数。

不用注册。没有广告。做题需要联网。

可以做什么
- BTT、FTT、RTT 三个分页分别练习
- 按章节刷题
- 每题即时批改
- 章节结束显示分数
- 在 App 里打开 BTT / FTT / RTT Handbook PDF

这不是什么
驾考宝典不是新加坡警察部队或交通警察的官方 App。不是计时模拟考，也不包含实操路考。

考试前请确认你用的是现行 Handbook。
